# Turn off / edit access
{: .no_toc }

Confirm turning off access, or edit term/source.
{: .fs-6 .fw-300 }

| | |
|---|---|
| **Screen ID** | `ACX-03` |
| **Route** | `/admin/entitlements/:entId` · deep link `substratal://admin/entitlements/:entId` |
| **Who can use it** | entitlements.manage or app owner |
| **Kind** | confirm |
| **Available in** | All Hub apps (MVP) |
| **On Linux** | `AdwAlertDialog` (`extra-child` for fields) |

## What's on this screen

| Element | What it is | Shows / does | Rules | On Linux |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Title | text |  | "Turn off {app} for {name}?" | GtkLabel |
| Reason | text-field | body.disabled_reason | optional; audit | AdwEntryRow |
| Edit term (advanced) | disclosure | ends_at, source trial→purchase, order_id | hidden for platform-managed rows | AdwExpanderRow |

## What happens when you act

| Action | API call | Result |
|---|---|---|
| Turn off | `PATCH /entitlements/{id} {status:disabled, disabled_reason} (If-Match)` | 409 version_conflict → reload and re-apply |
| Save changes | `PATCH /entitlements/{id}` |  |

## Good to know

- **Loading, empty and error states:** Loading: skeleton after 300 ms; Error: inline with Retry; codes per COPY-AND-STATES

## For developers

Loads: `GET /entitlements/{id}`

Every call sends `Substratal-Version: 1` to `https://api.substratalapps.com` (no `/v1` in the path). See [API versioning]({{ '/api/versioning/' | relative_url }}) and the [API reference]({{ '/api/reference/' | relative_url }}).
